subject.title: feat(codex): allow configured app-server provider ids

question: Should the Codex plugin expose `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported way for operators to let the native Codex app-server harness claim custom Codex-configured provider IDs?
rationale: This is a useful advanced capability, but it adds a new provider-routing config surface that affects auth/provider selection and security boundaries, so automation should not decide the permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept explicit allowlist
options.body: Land the current plugin-local allowlist direction after rebase and exact-head checks, keeping the default `codex`/`openai` behavior unchanged.

options.title: Derive from Codex config
options.body: Ask for a design that reads or validates configured Codex `model_providers` instead of requiring a parallel OpenClaw allowlist.

options.title: Defer custom Codex providers
options.body: Keep the Codex harness limited to built-in OpenClaw provider IDs until maintainers want to support custom Codex provider routing.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit allowlist
recommendation.body: Land the current plugin-local allowlist direction after rebase and exact-head checks, keeping the default `codex`/`openai` behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced and recently maintained the Codex app-server harness/config surface, making him the strongest history-based owner for this product-contract choice.
